network.info: Connections from inside the sandbox only reach allowed destinations. When the agent's work fails with network errors, the blocked destinations show up here. Only allow destinations you recognize.

network.confirmAllow:
Allow connections to {{host}}?

• Applies only to this project's sandbox ({{sandbox}})
• Once allowed, the agent can send data to this destination
• If you don't recognize the destination, don't allow it
• This can't be undone here (use sbx policy rm to remove it)

editor.conflict: The agent changed this file, so your edits were saved to {{path}}.
editor.shortcutsHelp:
Editing keys:
• {{mod}}Z / {{redo}}: undo / redo
• {{mod}}F: find & replace ({{mod}}G for next)
• {{alt}}{{mod}}G: go to line
• Tab / {{shift}}Tab: indent / outdent
• {{alt}}↑ / {{alt}}↓: move line up / down
• {{shift}}{{alt}}↑ / {{shift}}{{alt}}↓: duplicate line up / down
• {{shift}}{{mod}}K: delete line
• {{mod}}D: also select next occurrence
• {{mod}}+click: add cursor
• {{alt}}+drag: rectangular selection
• Esc then Tab: move focus out of the editor
Note: {{mod}}← / {{mod}}→ don't switch tabs while typing
